messages:
Welcome to EverLife - A Journey to Save Earth. 
            You are a chosen guardian, blessed with elemental powers by the ancient spirits. 
            Your mission: Save this land from environmental destruction caused by the mysterious Blight Corporation.
            Click "Go Forward" to begin your destiny.

The spirits materialize before you - manifestations of Water, Earth, Wind, and Fire.
            They speak in unison: "The land cries out in pain. The Scorched Plains, once verdant and alive,
            now lies dying under the corruption of industrial waste and toxic emissions."

The spirits offer you their power. But wielding all elements requires great responsibility.
            Which element calls to you most strongly?

options.text: Water - The element of healing and adaptation
Earth - The element of protection and strength
Wind - The element of freedom and speed
Fire - The element of passion and change

messages:
The Water Spirit envelops you in a cool mist. You feel its healing energy flow through you.
            "Use our blessing to cleanse the corruption and restore life to these lands."

The Earth Spirit's energy grounds you with ancient strength.
            "Our power shall help you protect what remains and rebuild what was lost."

The Wind Spirit's essence dances around you like a playful breeze.
            "Let our swiftness guide you to where you're needed most."

The Fire Spirit's warmth ignites your inner strength.
            "Our flame will help you forge a new path for this wounded world."

As you step into the Scorched Plains, you see the devastation firsthand.
            Withered trees reach toward a smog-filled sky. The ground is cracked and lifeless.
            In the distance, dark smoke rises from Blight Corporation's main facility.

A group of local villagers approaches you. They look desperate.
            "Please, our water supply has been contaminated by the factory's waste.
            But there's also a forest fire spreading from their careless operations."

As you approach the contaminated reservoir, a monster emerges!
            The corruption has taken physical form!

Racing toward the burning forest, you encounter a Fire Elemental corrupted by industrial waste!
            It's spreading the flames intentionally!

After the battle, you discover a disturbing truth. These corrupted beings
            were once pure nature spirits, twisted by Blight Corporation's experiments
            with forbidden technology.

A wounded security guard from Blight Corporation lies before you.
            He offers to help you infiltrate the facility in exchange for healing.
            However, a local environmentalist warns that it could be a trap.

The guard, grateful for your mercy, reveals a secret entrance
            and provides you with his keycard. "Be careful," he warns,
            "They're working on something big in the lower levels."

Your refusal angers the guard, who reveals himself as a corrupted shapeshifter!
            The trap is sprung!

You discover Blight Corporation's true plan. They're not just polluting the land -
            they're harvesting the corruption itself as an energy source.
            Each act of destruction makes them stronger.

In the facility's research lab, you find evidence of two urgent threats:
            A massive toxic waste dump about to leak into the underground aquifer,
            and a new superweapon about to be tested that will accelerate global warming.

The toxic waste has gained sentience! A massive Pollution Behemoth rises from the dump,
            its very presence corrupting everything around it!

The superweapon is protected by the CEO's personal guard - a cybernetically enhanced
            warrior powered by corrupted spirit energy!

Your actions have weakened Blight Corporation, but the CEO, Dr. Mara Blight,
            reveals herself. "You understand nothing! The old world is dying anyway.
            We're simply accelerating the inevitable and profiting from it!"

Dr. Blight offers you a choice: "Join us! Help us manage the world's end.
            We can ensure some survive, rebuild in our image. Or die fighting for a lost cause."

options.text: Never! The Earth can be saved!
Pretend to accept and infiltrate deeper

messages: Dr. Blight unleashes her security force!

You feign acceptance. Dr. Blight smiles coldly, "Wise choice. Follow me
        to your... orientation." Her hesitation makes you uneasy.

Deeper in the facility, you discover rows of massive tanks. Each contains
        a captured nature spirit, their essence being slowly corrupted and drained.

You find the spirit containment control system. You could:
        Release all spirits at once, causing chaos but maximum damage to the facility,
        or carefully free them one by one, taking longer but ensuring their safety.

The freed spirits rampage through the facility! But some have been corrupted
        beyond recognition. A Chaos Storm Spirit attacks you!

You begin carefully freeing the spirits. Each one grants you a portion of
        their remaining power in gratitude. You feel your abilities growing stronger.

An alarm blares through the facility. Dr. Blight's voice echoes:
        "Intruder in the spirit containment sector! Release the Hybrid Units!"

The Hybrid Units arrive - half-human, half-spirit beings, forcibly fused
        with corrupted essence. Their faces show pain behind their rage.

You notice the Hybrid Units have spirit cores that could be purified.
        But attempting this would leave you vulnerable to their attacks.

Your purification attempt works! The freed humans are confused but grateful.
        They offer to help you navigate the facility's deeper levels.

The Hybrid Units are defeated, but their final moments of anguish will
        haunt you. At least they're free from their torment now.

You find Dr. Blight's personal logs. They reveal she was once an environmental
        scientist who became convinced that humanity's doom was inevitable.

The logs contain access codes to either: The facility's power core,
        or the executive elevator to Dr. Blight's office. Choose your approach:
Enemy appeared!

The executive elevator opens to Dr. Blight's office - but it's empty.
        A hidden door behind her desk leads to a secret laboratory.

You uncover schematics for something called "Project Eclipse" -
        a massive device designed to accelerate climate change worldwide.
Enemy appeared!

After defeating the robots, you find a map of corruption spreaders -
        devices planted throughout the Scorched Plains that poison the land.

You can't disable all the spreaders before Project Eclipse activates.
        You must choose: Disable the spreaders to save this region, or push
        forward to stop Project Eclipse and save the world.

You race across the Scorched Plains, disabling corruption spreaders.
        With each one destroyed, you feel the land begin to heal.

You press deeper into the facility, knowing the region will suffer
        but determined to prevent global catastrophe.
Enemy appeared!

Beyond the serpent's chamber, you find a massive underground cavern.
        Pipes feed pollution directly into the earth's crust.

You detect unstable spirit energy below. You could:
        Redirect the pollution into the facility's systems, or
        try to contain the energy itself first.

The facility's systems overload as pollution floods back through them.
        Alarms blare as containment starts failing throughout the complex.

As you work to contain the spirit energy, Dr. Blight's elite guard attack!
        These warriors are infused with concentrated corruption!

You've reached the lowest level. Here, ancient spirit wards have been
        corrupted and reversed, actively pulling poison into the earth.

The wards manifest as Corrupted Ward Guardians! These twisted spirits
        attack with both elemental and pollution-based powers!

You've discovered the heart of the corruption - a massive spirit core,
            stolen from the Earth itself. Its power is being perverted to fuel
            Blight Corporation's operations worldwide.

Dr. Blight merges with the corrupted spirit core, becoming a monstrous
            manifestation of pollution and industrial might!

The spirit core is unstable. You could attempt to purify it,
            but the process might destroy everything nearby. Or try to contain it,
            which is safer but may allow some corruption to survive.

options.text: Risk everything to purify it completely

messages:
You channel all your power into the core. The purification releases
            an explosion of pure spiritual energy, destroying the facility but
            beginning an immediate restoration of the land!

You create a containment field around the core. The land will take longer
            to heal, but the process will be stable and lasting. New growth already
            begins to emerge from the scorched earth.

The spirits return, their power restored. "You have done well, guardian.
            But this is just one battle. Other lands cry out for healing, and
            more corrupt corporations threaten the Earth's balance."
Will you continue your mission to heal the Earth?

options.text: Yes, my journey is just beginning
I need rest before the next battle

messages:
Congratulations! You've completed the first chapter of EverLife.
            The Scorched Plains begin to heal, but new adventures await in distant lands.
            Thank you for playing!

Congratulations! You've completed the first chapter of EverLife.
            Rest well, guardian. The Earth will need your strength again soon.
            Thank you for playing!
